title: Fixed L Slot Sleeve and Twin Lug Tube Display
description: One newly authored complete fixed two-part pipe-connector illustrative display. A single continuous thick female tube wall contains two actual opposed open-ended L-shaped through paths, each with an axial mouth followed by a finite circumferential return and closed stop. A separate complete coaxial male tube has a real full-length bore and two integral radial lugs sharing its wall boundary. The halves remain axially separated on two whole short lower saddles and one common finite display bed so the positive ears and negative slot paths can be read without pretending that motion has been solved. Both whole mouths remain open. This is not the old external eccentric-cam lever sleeve or the interleaved three-jaw coupling with a separate spider insert: the new relation uses actual rim-open turning tracks and integral tube ears, without external levers, a closure disk or an elastomer insert. All geometry independently authored, no old connector meshes imported. Three opaque solid PBR roles, metres Z up, whole horizontal envelope centred, one connector display model zero scenes. Fixed artistic bayonet-style appearance only, not a weapon or tool blade. No insertion path, twist motion, locking, standardized fit, sealing, fluid flow, pressure, torque, load, manufacture, installation or mechanical safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made or verified.
